key_provisions_or_claims: Consumer Privacy Protection Act strengthens consent, transparency, data portability and disposal rights, and protections for minors
Fines up to 5% of global revenue or $25 million for the most serious privacy offences
Artificial Intelligence and Data Act requires high-impact AI systems to identify, assess and mitigate risks of harm and bias
Creates an AI and Data Commissioner with powers to monitor compliance and order third-party audits
Criminal prohibitions on use of unlawfully obtained data for AI and on reckless deployment causing serious harm
annotation.summary_en: Canadian government web summary of Bill C-27, the Digital Charter Implementation Act, 2022. It introduces the Consumer Privacy Protection Act, the Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (risk-based rules for high-impact AI, an AI and Data Commissioner, criminal prohibitions) and the Personal Information and Data Protection Tribunal Act.
